title: All Church Camping Weekend at Reunion Flat
location: Church in the Tetons, 60 South Main St, Driggs, ID 83422
description: Under the Canopy of God’s Creation – CiT Outdoor Retreat Signup Here Where : Reunion Flats Campground Site B. When : Friday August 28th-Sunday August 30th: campers can check in after 2pm on the 28th, and everyone must be checked out by noon on the 30th. Shared meal : Saturday Aug 29th, 5:30PM, Nacho Bar, there will be paper sign ups to attend and bring food every Sunday at church and electronically on the CiT website, Ministry of Fun will provide paper products, water and lemonade, and set up gas camp stoves and hopefully fire in the fire ring if permitted at that time. Vespers (evening service) Saturday Aug. 29th, 7P: devotional and music to give thanks to God for all his glory and creation. Immediately following there will be a dessert contest, asking everyone to bring their best smores creations. Sunday 30th: bagels, fruit and coffee provided for those who are camping, it’s service Sunday, so those at the campground will be sent off to projects in prayer by AJ. There will be at least 1 service project in Reunion Flats. The Mission Team will be providing service project ideas/signups closer to the weekend. Directions: Head east out of Driggs on E. Ski Hill Road toward Alta, WY. Turn right onto Forest Road 009 and go 3 miles to the campground. The last 2 miles of the drive is a gravel road and easily drivable in any type of car. We will put up signs along the route for easy wayfinding. Parking: there is ample parking at the site, enough for 12 cars/trucks, and overflow parking is a short walk/shuttle to Treasure Lake Area. We will make sure everyone has a place to park and shuttle anyone as needed. Good things to know: There are lots of spots to tent camp on this site. Again, helpful if groups/individuals camping, sign up on paper or website. We can also make room for small hard sided campers. If someone wishes to bring one,please sign up. It is primitive camping, no hookups. There is potable water for cooking and washing, but we recommend you bring water to stay hydrated. There are 2 picnic tables we can dine on, and camp chairs would be good to bring. This is the most shaded area of this campground and we will set up a canopy/shade shelter as well. There are lots of hikes, streams, fishing spots, biking trails in the area. More info to come about a possible guided hike for all, and treasure hunt for kids. Save the Date Learn More
